It also holds the Circle Valley gold project in the Albany-Fraser belt and acquired Mt Holland South in 2026.

mine_info.wikipedia_summary: Kalgoorlie, also known as Kalgoorlie–Boulder, is a city in the Goldfields–Esperance region of Western Australia, located 595 km (370 mi) east-northeast of Perth at the end of the Great Eastern Highway. It is referred to as Kalgoorlie–Boulder as the surrounding urban area includes the historic townsite of Boulder and the local government area is the City of Kalgoorlie–Boulder.

company_brief.summary: Bellevue Gold Limited is a Western Australian gold producer whose sole operating asset is the Bellevue Gold Project, an underground high-grade gold mine about 40km north of Leinster in the Agnew-Wiluna greenstone belt of WA's Northern Goldfields. The mine poured first gold in late 2023 and now produces from lodes including Deacon, Deacon North and Tribune South, with a mineral resource of roughly 3.1Moz at ~9 g/t gold. All drilling activity is exploration and resource-definition work within the Bellevue tenement package; the company holds no other material projects.

company_brief.summary: Tesoro Gold Limited (formerly Tesoro Resources; renamed April 2022) is a Fremantle-based gold explorer and developer whose sole focus is the El Zorro Gold Project in the Atacama region of northern Chile, in which it holds a ~95% interest. Its flagship asset is the Ternera gold deposit, which carries a Mineral Resource Estimate of about 1.82 Moz of gold and is currently the subject of a Definitive Feasibility Study. The wider El Zorro land package covers several hundred square kilometres and contains additional early-stage gold prospects such as La Brea, Drone Hill, Pena Blanca and Calderillas.
projects: El Zorro district prospects (La Brea, Drone Hill, Pena Blanca, Calderillas, Ternera East, Buzzard)

company_brief.summary: Kaiser Reef Limited (ASX: KAU) is an Australian gold producer and explorer. It owns and operates the Henty Gold Mine in western Tasmania (underground mine plus a 300,000tpa CIL plant, ~26koz Au in FY25, acquired from Catalyst Metals in 2025) and the Maldon Gold Project in central Victoria, which includes the permitted Union Hill underground mine and a 200,000tpa processing plant. Its earlier Victorian asset, the A1 Gold Mine, has been placed on care and maintenance following a strategic review, and its former NSW copper-gold ground (Macquarie North) was divested.

company_brief.summary: Catalyst Metals is an ASX-listed gold producer whose business is centred on the Plutonic Gold Belt in Western Australia, where it mines Plutonic Main, Plutonic East, the Trident open pit/underground and K2, all feeding the company-owned Plutonic processing mill. It produced about 104,000oz in FY26 and is developing Trident underground, Old Highway (bought from Sandfire) and Cinnamon to lift output toward roughly 200,000oz a year. company_brief.summary: Ausgold Limited is a Perth-based gold developer whose flagship asset is the 100%-owned Katanning Gold Project (KGP) in the Katanning Greenstone Belt of Western Australia's south-west Yilgarn Craton, about 275km southeast of Perth. A Definitive Feasibility Study was completed in 2025 and updated in 2026, and the company is progressing early works, permitting and financing toward a final investment decision and first production. Ausgold also runs regional gold exploration across roughly 3,000km2 of surrounding Katanning tenure, and has farmed out the Kulin gold project to Critica.

Kalgoorlie Gold Mining Limited (KalGold, ASX: KAL) is a gold exploration company based in West Perth that listed on the ASX in late 2020 and operates across Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields. Its flagship is the Pinjin Gold Project on the southern Laverton Tectonic Zone, which hosts the Kirgella Gift/Providence resource and the newer Lighthorse and Wessex discoveries. Secondary gold tenements include Bulong Taurus, La Mascotte, Perrinvale, Zelica, Ninga Mia and a recently acquired package in the Central Yandal belt; the Yarri tenements were sold.
projects: Pinjin (incl. Kirgella Gift, Providence, Lighthorse, Wessex, Rebecca West)

company_brief.summary: MetalsGrove Mining is an ASX-listed gold explorer whose entire current portfolio is the Central West Gold Project in Cote d'Ivoire: four joint-venture exploration permits (Zuenoula, Vavoua, Vavoua West, Kounahiri West) covering 1,315 km2 of Birimian greenstone belts. The projects are early-stage, with soil sampling defining targets and first auger drilling commencing at Zuenoula in 2026. Its earlier Australian (NT/WA) lithium, rare-earth and copper-gold prospects and Zimbabwe lithium assets no longer appear on the company's site.

Wia Gold Limited (formerly Tanga Resources) is an ASX-listed gold explorer and developer whose sole active asset is the Kokoseb Gold Project in the Damaran Belt of north-west Namibia, held 80% in joint venture with state-owned Epangelo. Kokoseb has a July 2025 Mineral Resource Estimate of 2.93 Moz at 1.0 g/t gold, a completed scoping study, and a definitive feasibility study underway, funded by a A$92m placement in May 2026. The company divested its non-core Cote d'Ivoire exploration assets in early 2026.

rogozna_gold_and_base_metals_project.label: Rogozna Gold and Base Metals Project

company_brief.summary: Strickland Metals is an ASX-listed gold and base metals explorer whose sole flagship is the Rogozna gold-copper project in the Raska district of southern Serbia, with a combined resource of about 9.2Moz AuEq across the Shanac, Gradina, Medenovac and Copper Canyon deposits. It divested its Western Australian assets: Millrose was sold to Northern Star in 2023 and the remaining Yandal project was sold to Gateway Mining in 2026, with Gateway shares distributed in-specie to holders. The company is advancing development studies at Rogozna alongside a large ongoing drill program.
projects: Rogozna (Shanac, Gradina, Medenovac, Copper Canyon deposits; Kotlovi, Obradov Potok, Jezerska Reka, Red Creek prospects)

company_brief.summary: Artemis Resources is a gold and copper exploration company focused on the Karratha district in Western Australia's West Pilbara, where it holds the Greater Carlow gold-copper-cobalt deposit (Inferred MRE, Oct 2022) and the newer Titan / Titan East gold discovery. It is also exploring the Cassowary IOCG copper-gold target in the Madura Province about 450 km east of Kalgoorlie, and retains a lithium joint-venture interest at Osborne with GreenTech Metals. It formerly held the Munni Munni PGM project (sold 2022) and Paterson Central (no longer an active project).
projects: Karratha Gold-Copper Project (Carlow, Titan/Titan East, Lulu Creek)

company_brief.summary: Tribune Resources is a gold producer and explorer whose core asset is a 12.25% interest in the East Kundana Joint Venture (EKJV), producing underground gold mines near Kalgoorlie, Western Australia, operated by Evolution Mining alongside JV partner Rand Mining. It also holds the Japa Gold Project in Ghana, centred on the Adiembra deposit with a maiden resource of 1.81 Moz, and an interest in the Diwalwal Gold Project in Mindanao, Philippines. The ticker has not been recycled — Tribune has been the same gold-focused company throughout its listed history.

Gibb River Diamonds (formerly POZ Minerals, renamed 2020) is a Perth-based explorer and small-scale gold producer. Its flagship is the Edjudina Gold Project 145 km north-east of Kalgoorlie, WA, where mining of the Neta deposit began in late 2024 with ore toll-treated under a partnership with BML Ventures. It also holds the Ellendale 9 alluvial diamond prospect in the Kimberley (WA), the Iroquois zinc-lead project in the Earaheedy Basin (WA), the Highland Plains phosphate project, and greenfield uranium licences in Namibia acquired in June 2024.

Superior Resources is a Queensland-focused mineral explorer. Its flagship is the Greenvale Project west of Townsville, containing the Steam Engine gold deposit (feasibility-stage, updated MRE Nov 2025) plus the Bottletree, Cockie Creek and Halls Reward/Telegraph porphyry copper-gold prospects. It also holds the Nicholson and Victor zinc projects in the Carpentaria Zinc Province of north-west Queensland.

New Age Exploration is an ASX-listed minerals explorer focused on gold in the Pilbara region of Western Australia and the Otago region of New Zealand. Its flagship is the Wagyu Gold Project in the central Pilbara, within a ~1,893 sq km gold-lithium tenement package, alongside the Lammerlaw gold-antimony project and other Otago gold permits in New Zealand. In March 2026 it acquired the Wallah Silver Project near Yass in the NSW Lachlan Fold Belt. All projects are exploration stage with no mineral resource estimates.
